title: Peppered Sea Scallops With Spinach
description: An easy but elegant full-flavored main course featuring generously peppered sea scallops served over Indian-spiced spinach purée.

ingredients.name: sea scallops
ingredients.quantity: 12 large (about 1 pound), trimmed and patted dry

steps.instruction: Make the spinach purée by heating the butter or oil in a wide skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and cook until fragrant and beginning to pop, about 1 minute.
Add the onion and cook until softened and barely browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, jalapeño, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric. Cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach, season with salt and cayenne, then add the white wine.
Cook, stirring, until the spinach is just wilted, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer the spinach mixture to a blender or food processor and blend with enough water to make a medium-thick purée. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Pour the spinach purée into a small saucepan and keep warm over low heat.
Season the scallops on both sides with salt and generous amounts of coarse black pepper.
Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the scallops without crowding the pan and cook undisturbed for about 5 minutes until browned on one side.
Flip the scallops carefully and cook for about 2 more minutes until opaque on the sides.
Spoon the warm spinach purée into serving plates, top with scallops, sprinkle with lemon zest, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and serve.
